description:
We are Team ORI SPACE 🚀 at NASA Space Apps!
Inspired by the word 'Origin' and the mighty 'Orion' constellation, we are a dynamic team of innovators ready to be the starting point for groundbreaking ideas. Powered by NASA’s open data and a passion for technology, we aim to transform complex challenges into real-world solutions for Earth and beyond. The journey begins here, and our ambition knows no limits! ✨🌍
